module.Title: Name the Facility
module.Teaching: A variable gives a value a reusable name. Python creates the variable when you assign a value with =.
module.PredictionQuestion: Which symbol assigns a value to a variable?
module.PredictionExplanation: A single equals sign assigns the value on the right to the name on the left.
module.DebugPrompt: Use one equals sign for assignment; two equals signs compare values.
module.RecallPrompt: Create facility_name with the text "Crystal Cavern".
module.TransferPrompt: Create controller_name with the text "Cave Pi 1".
module.PreviewMessage: The control room now knows the facility name.
